label: daily-unwrap-gate-aligned
description: Unwrap value gate (semantics/unwrap-gate-parsefloat-divergences): every unwrap query now carries the gate's per-row pipes (a copy, a conditional replace_regexp, a range filter after math, a counting stats group), so the common path must stay within noise of main. G1-G2 plain unwrap, G3-G4 with `| __error__=""`, G5-G6 sum by over rate, G7-G8 duration() and bytes(), G9 max, G10 every production stream, G11-G12 instant. All hold clean numbers, so the shapes measure the gate's cost, not an error path. Run with the control set.
